newsitem.title: USA: Shelter Components sets higher payout.
newsitem.headline: Shelter Components sets higher payout.

text.p: Shelter Components Corp said Tuesday its directors approved payment of a semiannual dividend of $0.03 a share, which translates to a 25 percent increase over the semi-annual dividend paid for the first half of the year by virtue of a five-for-four stock split in July 1996.
The dividend will be payable on December 18, to shareholders of record on December 4.
Shelter Components supplies hardware, fasteners, building products, floor covering, plumbing and electrical products to the manufactured housing, modular housing and recreational vehicle industries.
